'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Sometimes I think back to how the locals welcomed us when we first entered Tarkov. We thought the mission would be brief, but things did not go according to plan. We are currently facing shortages of supplies and fuel-related materials. Our deliveries have been disrupted, and the locals are no longer willing to assist us. We need your help, mercenary.}}

==Objectives==
* Hand over 5 items from the [[:Category:Household goods|Household goods]] category with the [[Found in raid]] status
* Hand over 5 items from the [[:Category:Flammable materials|Flammable materials]] category with the [[Found in raid]] status

==Rewards==
* +3,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Peacekeeper]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.1'''</font>
* 550 Dollars
** 578 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 632 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|Everything collected? Splendid! Dziękuję, mercenary.}}
